text:
Did you really jump down here?
Respect!
zh:
你真的跳下来了？
佩服！

text: Now, don't just stand there. Pull me up!
zh: 行了，别傻站着。拉我上去！

text: What was that?
zh: 刚才那是怎么回事？

text: *lend a hand
zh: *搭把手

text: Do it yourself.
zh: 你自己来吧。

text: I prefer to talk at eye level. Help me up first!
zh: 我喜欢平视着说话。先扶我起来！

text: Well, look who found their backbone.
zh: 哟，瞧瞧是谁长出骨气来了。

text: Hmpf!
zh: 哼！

text: Thanks, man!
zh: 谢了，伙计！

text: What was that?
zh: 刚才那是怎么回事？

text: What about the King's Ruby?
zh: 国王的红宝石是怎么回事？

text: Where are we?
zh: 我们这是在哪儿？

text: What should we do?
zh: 我们该怎么办？

text: That was me. Or at least... whatever's inside me.
zh: 那是我干的。或者说……是我身体里的那个东西干的。

text:
Argh!
Something's wrong with me. And it's more than I can explain.
zh:
呃啊！
我的身体不对劲。这事我自己也说不清。

text: I don't understand.
zh: 我不明白。

text:
Is it a curse? A damn demon?
Hell if I know.
zh:
是诅咒？还是哪个该死的恶魔？
鬼才知道。

text:
Whatever it is, it's messing with me.
Just happened again. I lost control over it.
zh:
不管那是什么，它在折腾我。
刚才又发作了。我控制不住它。

text: Don't you dare tell anyone. Balder's the only one who knows.
zh: 你敢说出去试试。这事只有巴尔德知道。

text: Jesse caught wind of someone giving the ruby to the king.
zh: 杰西听到风声，说有人把红宝石献给了国王。

text: With the ruby in hand, I needed to see if the tales were real.
zh: 红宝石一到手，我就得验证那些传说是不是真的。

text: Before the king could hide it, Jesse replaced the real ruby with a forgery.
zh: 趁国王还没把它藏起来，杰西用一枚赝品换走了真的红宝石。

text: Legend has it the King's Ruby enhances the inner strength of its wielder.
zh: 传说国王的红宝石能增强持有者的内在力量。

text: Which is how the ruby found its way into my hands.
zh: 红宝石就是这么落到我手里的。

text: My plan was to use it to break the curse. Or keep it sealed away forever.
zh: 我本打算用它破除诅咒。或者把那东西永远封印起来。

text: Apparently, the ruby didn't just strengthen me, but the thing inside me as well.
zh: 结果显然，红宝石不光增强了我，也增强了我身体里的那个东西。

text:
I don't know.
This place reminds me of the old mine Balder and I used to work in.
zh:
我不知道。
这地方让我想起我和巴尔德以前干活的那座旧矿井。

text: So, what do you want?
zh: 那么，你想干什么？

text: Hmpf!
zh: 哼！

text: Let's not just stand here. We should explore the area and find an exit.
zh: 别在这儿干站着。我们该四处探探，找条出路。

text:
Come on already!
You waiting for an invitation?
zh:
快点儿！
还等着人下请帖吗？
